title: Harness task contract
description: A request becomes this bounded object before any action. Blocks silent redefinition of the task.

goal.description: One sentence. What is true when this is done.

inputs.description: Files, URLs, data or prior artifacts the task may use. Empty is allowed for greenfield.

constraints.description: Hard limits: files not to touch, APIs not to call, budgets, style.

risk.description: reversible = only the workspace changes; shared = other people see it; irreversible = cannot be undone (deploy, delete, send).

check.description: A verifiable statement. Rejected when vague and no sensor is named.

sensor.description: Name of a sensor declared in the graph that proves this check.
